attributes.residual: MIXED and CAPPED on the short side, with a REFUTATION as the session's deliverable. (A) THE LAW'S OUTCOME HOLDS AND IS STRONGER: the short-side sites @144, @ab4 and @bcc are now closed against FIVE distinct source spellings (de Morgan and block-bodied positive guard from v2; `&&`-unnesting, merged `||` disjunction and `else if` chain from this pass), every one byte-identical with real 492, T1306/O1306 and the 18-token multiset unmoved. Do not spend a sixth spelling. (B) THE LAW'S STATED MECHANISM IS FALSE, and this is the correction the next agent needs. The law instructs: 'confirm the guard body's transfer reaches the EPILOGUE -- a return, or a goto to a label whose only content is the return path. If it reaches an interior label, the site is closed and no spelling will open it.' The TARGET'S OWN BYTES contradict that at the very sites the law was derived from. Read `fnasm.py game/world/items.c SetItem 0x130:0x170 --diff`: the target's pair is `144: bne ->14c` (the guard body's `continue`, to the loop latch) followed by `148: b ->164`, and 0x164 is `mulli r0,r21,80` -- that is `keyring_found`, an INTERIOR label reached by fallthrough from `160: li r21,-1`. The forward branch pair therefore DOES exist in MWCC output with an interior, non-epilogue target, so an epilogue target is NOT a necessary condition and the law's cheap-screen step (b) will wrongly close live sites in other functions. The law also mis-assigns roles: the pair's conditional branch is the guard body's transfer to the LATCH, while the unconditional `b` is the SEPARATE trailing goto statement, so screening 'where the guard body goes' inspects the wrong statement. (C) WHAT IS ACTUALLY UNKNOWN is a scheduling/block-layout property, not a guard property: in the target the trailing `goto` survives as its own basic block and the latch is laid out after it, whereas in every one of our five spellings MWCC folds the last guard's inversion into the goto and lays the latch out as the fallthrough. No law in the current corpus names a source lever over that block ordering, and the guard-expression axis is exhausted. (D) SURPLUS SIDE unchanged and still UNBANKABLE ALONE: @790/@79c is diagnosed (one field spelled two ways; the single-spelling cure removes the reload but breaks the fake parity and cascades real 492 -> 703), @318 diagnosed but unprobed (target emits one `li r17,0` serving both the byte store at 206(r31) and the live variable). The joint short+surplus edit the superseded record named as the one open lever REMAINS UNAVAILABLE: three attempts produced no short-side instruction to pay for a surplus removal. (E) @bf4/@c14 address-PRE and the net-zero entry cluster are unchanged settled classes.
